name: Bio-energy potential
derivation: Sum of the biomass and cogeneration-bagasse potential streams per state (both are additive components of the same buildable bio-energy capacity).

name: Transmission substation capacity commissioned (MVA)
derivation: Sum of nameplate substation capacity (MVA) commissioned each fiscal year, grouped by governing voltage class (the highest winding voltage of each asset, bucketed into hvdc / 765kv / 400kv / 220kv / other). National only - the feed has no per-state attribution.
